name: smwmusic-sacred-harp-soar-away
title: Sacred Harp - Soar Away
description:
A theme that starts quiet and goes epic. Could possibly fit a castle, a temple or an airship. In the lyrics it is supposed to represent the joy to ascend to paradise, so that "final" tag is pretty much real.

This updates and replaces the former release. As recommended it has more bass punch and some panning.
